subject: Azure Marketplace Private SKU - Entitlement Mapping, SOC2 Evidence & Billing Routing
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@contoso.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@contoso.com>, Azure Marketplace Specialist <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Private SKU entitlement mapping + SOC2 evidence for Contoso onboarding

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Contoso is ready to move forward with the private SKU on Azure Marketplace, but we need a few items to finalize the PO and internal approval: 

- A mapping of Azure Marketplace entitlements (metering/seat counts) to our internal SKUs — we need to show licensing to finance.
- SOC2 attestation and a short description of data flow for our security team.
- Billing and invoice routing instructions for our AP team (they require an email and billing contact).

Can you provide the entitlement mapping workbook and the SOC2 doc? Also, if there are any changes to the standard private plan terms (SLA/termination/entitlement clauses), please flag them so our legal can take a quick look.

Targeting a PO this month — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Procurement Lead, Contoso
maria.lopez@contoso.com
+1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: Contoso_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private SKU entitlement mapping + SOC2 evidence for Contoso onboarding

Hi Maria — thanks, glad the demo was useful.

Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Entitlement mapping: attached an initial worksheet that maps Marketplace entitlement types to Contoso SKUs and suggested seat/instance metrics. Please review the "Assumptions" tab — if Contoso uses org-level seats vs. per-user seats we can adjust.
2) SOC2 evidence: attached our SOC2 attestation PDF and a two-page summary describing typical data flow for private deployments. For Azure Private Plan we recommend the additional note under Data Processing: customer-managed storage keys if you require separation.
3) Billing & invoice routing: our standard is to send invoices to billing@redwood.ai, but for marketplace private SKUs we can route invoices directly to Contoso AP. Please confirm the AP contact and PO number format.

I've looped in Karthik from Legal for any term deviations and Ben from Sales to help with entitlement questions. If it's helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk the mapping and SOC2 items. Availability: 10–11am or 3–4pm PT.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0922

[Attachments: Contoso_Entitlement_Map.xlsx, Contoso-SOC2-Attestation.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@contoso.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private SKU entitlement mapping + SOC2 evidence for Contoso onboarding

Hi Maria — small legal note after quick pass on the private plan terms Rachel shared: 

- We have proposed a limited modification to the standard termination notice to align with marketplace private plan constraints (see section 7.2). This is a commercial exception and will require a countersignature.
- If Contoso needs explicit audit rights beyond SOC2 attestation (on-prem access requests), that will need to be scoped as an addendum.

Attached is a redline (Redwood_PrivatePlan_Terms_v1.2.docx) with highlighted clauses. Can you confirm whether Contoso will need the addendum for audit rights? If not, the redline should be acceptable to your legal team.

Laura, FYI — once Maria confirms we'll prepare the countersign path and DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

[Attachment: Redwood_PrivatePlan_Terms_v1.2.docx (docx)]

From: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@contoso.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@contoso.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private SKU entitlement mapping + SOC2 evidence for Contoso onboarding

Thanks, team. Quick replies from Contoso side: 

- Entitlement mapping looks good overall. We have one question in the "Assumptions" sheet about auto-scaling instances — Finance wants to see capped license counts for budgeting. Can you add a column for "recommended cap"?
- Legal: Contoso Legal is OK with the redline except we need the audit addendum scoped — we don't need full on-site access, just a quarterly compliance report and the ability to request evidence with 30 days' notice. Can you propose language for that addendum?
- Billing: Please route invoices to ap@contoso.com and cc: accounting-ops@contoso.com. PO format will be CT-#######.

If you can get the updated mapping with 'recommended cap' and proposed audit-addendum language by next Tuesday (21 Jul), we can finalize the PO and route to AP.

Appreciate the quick turn.

-David
David Nguyen
Director, IT Procurement — Contoso
+1 206-555-0094

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@contoso.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private SKU entitlement mapping + SOC2 evidence for Contoso onboarding

Hi David / Maria —

Thanks for the detailed feedback. Deliverables in this thread as of now: 

1) Updated entitlement workbook: added "recommended cap" column and a short rationale per SKU. (See updated attachment).
2) Proposed Audit Addendum: drafted language that allows Contoso to request quarterly compliance reports and ad-hoc evidence requests with 30 days' notice; clarified that typical SOC2 artifacts (scoped controls) will be provided unless Contoso opts for a scoped audit addendum that includes extra evidence. Attached for your review.
3) Terms redline: Karthik's redline updated to include cross-reference to the audit addendum.

Next steps: once you confirm the addendum language we will generate a DocuSign envelope for countersignature and route the final invoice to ap@contoso.com (cc accounting-ops@contoso.com) with PO prefix CT-.

DocuSign link (draft): https://docusign.com/tx/ABCD-1234-CTSO

I attached the three files here: Contoso_Entitlement_Map.xlsx (updated), Redwood_PrivatePlan_Terms_v1.2.docx (redline), Contoso-SOC2-Attestation.pdf.

If everything looks good I'll send the DocuSign envelope by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0922

[Attachments: Contoso_Entitlement_Map.xlsx, Redwood_PrivatePlan_Terms_v1.2.docx, Contoso-SOC2-Attestation.pdf]
